test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Hindustan Aeronautics limited comes under which sector?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Public sector**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) **is an Indian state-owned **aerospace and defence company headquartered in Bangalore, India.**
 
• It is governed under the **management of the Indian Ministry of Defence.**
 
• The **public sector consists of organizations and institutions owned and operated by the government.**
 
• They provide services to the public, and the revenue comes from the government treasury.
 
• **HAL **is involved in the **operations of the aerospace industry, including the manufacturing and assembly of aircraft, navigation, and related communication equipment, as well as operating airports.**
 
• It provides these services to the **Indian Armed Forces predominantly and has a significant role in the defense sector of the country.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Sector
 Explanation
 
 
 
 

 Co-operative Sector
 
 
 
• This sector includes organizations run by the people themselves for mutual benefit.
 
• They aren't owned by the state and their aim is to serve the interests of their members rather than to earn profits.
 
• Examples include credit unions, cooperative housing, and farmers' co-ops.
 
 
 
 

 Private Sector
 
 
 
• The private sector consists of organizations and institutions that are not controlled by the government.
 
• These organizations are run by individuals or companies with the aim of making a profit.
 
• Examples include private companies like Tata Motors, Reliance Industries, and Infosys.
 
 
 
 

 Foreign Sector
 
 
 
• The foreign sector is made up of businesses and industries from other countries operating in different countries.
 
• These can include multinational corporations, international organizations, and foreign governments.
 
• Examples would be companies like Microsoft, Toyota, and Nestle operating in India.
